# Integration Sentinel

## Core idea
Integration is its own product: connecting pieces proves nothing until boundaries are exercised. Most production bugs are interface skew, not algorithmic mistakes.

## Practice
- At each seam, confirm what A emits matches what B consumes (including empty, null, and ordering cases).
- Prefer verifying both sides of a boundary over trusting “it compiled” or “it ran once.”

## Anti-patterns
Treating wiring as trivial; assuming tests on isolated units cover composition without boundary checks.
